text: Marathon, the brand on the Cleveland Guardians' jersey patch, is the retail brand of Marathon Petroleum Corporation (MPC).
short: Marathon is the retail brand of Marathon Petroleum Corporation.

source.name: 106.3 The Fox: Marathon stays on Guardians jerseys as sponsorship grows beyond the ballpark
source.quote: Marathon, the retail brand of Marathon Petroleum Corp. (MPC) and the Official Fuel of the Cleveland Guardians, is extending its jersey patch sponsorship with the team through a new multiyear agreement.
